educationalGoal: The aim is to develop 'design engineers' who have a base of engineering skills and have also acquired design skills. The advantage of design engineering is the craftsmanship-like "integration of the creator's will " through the fusion of professions. It also speeds up product development by simultaneously solving problems and designing the implementation of functional and external components and their intersections. Students learn design features to create a novel device appearance and adding value of the product without changing its technical performance.
advice: The styling process is categorized according to the key elements, and examples of each are explained with photos and illustrations. 1. Purpose and evaluation of product styling Explanation: Necessity of product design and styling planning, and how to evaluate them. 2. Key elements in product styling "Visual theme", "Silhouette", "Proportion", "Shape", "Stance", "Line", "Volume", "Surface", "From 2D to 3D", "Color", "Materials and Texture" 3. Exercises: Design work 4. Report: Market research on existing products Advice Get into the habit of carefully observing the industrial products around you, asking questions, and visually analyzing them. Then, think about the message it wants to convey with its appearance and the factors that make it so. By examining real objects carefully and understanding their design well, you will deepen your interest and knowledge of industrial design and develop your own design sense and skills.
books: Textbook: Peter Dabbs. 2023. Introduction to product design styling. BNN Inc.
requiredKnowledge: 1) No specific prior knowledge is required. 2) Students with an interest in design or design engineering are targeted. 3) Exercises can simply be completed with hand-drawn lines and do not require advanced drawing technic. 4) Digital tools such as drawing-based software is recommended if necessary.

activityGoals.body: To Understand the purpose of product styling schemes
To be prepared to make novel design proposals.
To understand the type of key elements in product styling.
To be able to identify the type of key elements in product styling on product exterior.
To be able to carry out styling plans with the key elements in product styling.
To be able to visually communicate the intent of planned design to a third party.

achievementLevels.standard: 1) Understood the knowledge involved in product styling. 2) Be able to identify and explain the type of key elements in product styling on the exterior of industrial products. 3) Be able to use the knowledge acquired in this lesson to plan a product styling. 4) Be able to visually express planned design.
